Dream 2026-11-22 linked 6 vignettes from 5 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- 2026-10-30 · touches · "I maintain sovereignty by doing the things I'm good at" (Vignette 2026-10-30: sovereignty is doing what I am good at)
- 2026-11-03 · touches · "becoming sovereign in their actions" (Local tooling for the housekeeping: a cybernetic, fractal, federated system of local AI (2026-11-03))
- 2026-11-05 · touches · "muDemocracy is a project about how we managed meaning as a group" (The essay editor preserves human agency for owning meaning as individuals; muDemocracy is how we manage meaning as a group (2026-11-05))
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "we need tools that support the thinking that humans need to do to actively stay part of the process" (The bigger domain is effective human/AI collaboration: preserve each party's strength, against the sweet usurpation of autonomy (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "We build the tools that empower people, rather than taking away their power." (Not a tool for anyone: power tools that protect the individual's sovereignty; imagine AI is fire, and learn when it is useful (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-07 · touches · "local ai requires that communities can govern well." (Nearby AI needs communities capable of maintenance: muDemocracy for governing, SRS and the relay for owning data, the essay editor for safe individual use; "dumb AI" is the right level of intelligence in the right place, "cybernetic AI" is fractal feedback, VSM (2026-11-07))
